info.title: MedSphere Auth Service API
info.description: OpenAPI documentation for the MedSphere Auth Service. This service owns authentication, identity, user profile endpoints, sessions, email flows, RBAC-protected admin identity operations, internal identity lookups, contact acknowledgement email handoff, and the currently hosted department endpoints.
